This '''private school''' was located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Half-sisters [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]] and [[Nandi]] attended here to study history, etiquette, hospitality, and the arts.
